It started with a freezer and two people in love.
Well, that escalated quickly. 😂🐔

Now we’ve got a farm and three little chicken tenders: Wyatt on the left, Willow in the middle and Waylon on the right.

New York, meet the Roswells. 💚

We’re Aj and Emily, building our family farm in Salisbury/Dolgeville, NY.

Emily works full time at North Star Recycling. I work full time on the farm—building, making improvements, feeding the animals and checking that they’re healthy every day.

Whenever we can be together, we do it together. That’s what makes this a family farm: the time we share caring for the animals and building something of our own.

Whether you’re down the road or across New York, you’re welcome to follow our story.

Come for the chicken outfits. Stay to see what we build next. 🐔🛸

The grill has rejected its retirement paperwork. 🍂🔥

Apparently, owning a sweatshirt means barbecue season can continue.

Here’s your fall cookout plan: chicken wings or drumsticks, pork ribs or sweet or hot sausage links. Add roasted potatoes, apple slaw and the person who clicks the tongs twice before doing absolutely anything.

Roswell Family Farm in Salisbury, New York, can help with the chicken and pork. You’re responsible for supervising the tong-clicker.
